q1: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS)
q2: SELECT C.NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS C LEFT JOIN ORDERS O ON C.ID = O.CUSTOMERID WHERE CUSTOMERID IS NULL
